content: German kid digital-safety ecosystem: klicksafe (EU initiative) splits kids/juveniles/parents sections; offers Themen, Materialien (PDFs, checklists e.g. Checkliste Mediensucht, quizzes e.g. Quiz Digitale Abhängigkeit, Digital Detox Box, #AUSzeit challenge), Erklärfilme, podcasts. Internet-ABC (6-12, ad-free, state media authorities) = gold standard: 15 interactive Lernmodule (Klassen 3-6, each with Quiz + Umfrage elements), Surfschein driving-license quiz, small games (Viren-Scanner, Smartphone-Spiel), Lexikon, Frag-uns mailbox with kids privacy statement, moderated comment sections, Digitale Pinnwand, Mein-erstes-Internet-ABC story; screen time guidance 11-12y: max 90 min/day or ~10h weekly budget. Mediennutzungsvertrag (with klicksafe) = online family media contract tool with age templates + parent rules, Pädi 2015 award. Handysektor (LFK BW, ~11-13y): Kurz-AGBs (plain-language app terms), Erklärvideos (WhatsApp-Stress), Real Life Challenge, topic picker (Sucht, Mobbing...), digitaler Erste-Hilfe-Kasten. fragFINN = whitelisted kid search + apps + FINNreporter. Seitenstark = kid-site network seal. JUUUPORT = teen peer advice + reporting. SCHAU HIN! = parent tips.
